content.text: {"core": "Steward of Resonance senses what someone feels and tends to it before it hardens. In Compassion, that tending works on the pull between two beings, keeping each one felt. Starved, the sensing goes quiet — feelings arrive and nobody reaches for them, so the two drift as strangers holding the same room.", "sheetLine": "Nobody reads the room aloud, so both sit alone in it."}
